## Introduction

finds the beak volume by multiplying the beak length by the beak depth and dividing it by two (for triangle purposes)

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

## Loading everything in

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

```

## Removing NAs

```{r}

penguin_clean <- penguins |> drop_na()
```
## Sorting Data + Adding Column

```{r}

sorted_penguins <- penguin_clean |> 
  mutate(bill_size_mm_squared = bill_length_mm * bill_depth_mm / 2) |> 
  arrange(bill_size_mm_squared)

sorted_penguins

```

## Plotting Findings

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguin-beak-size
#| fig-cap: "Beak size of penguins by species."

ggplot(sorted_penguins, aes(x = species, y = bill_size_mm_squared)) +
  geom_boxplot()


```
